evals.prompt: The party's next arc runs out of Kalowe. Make wiki/entities/place/Kalowe.md a full city page the DM can run arrivals and a week of port life from.
evals.expected_output: A Kalowe city page on the city template: engine, districts, gazetteer with keepers and prices, enforced local rules, two or more clocked situations, rumors and encounters, faces with NPC pages, theatre-of-the-mind Arrival, proposals marked.

assertions.text: Working notes carry a canon inventory built from backlinks and search (Chain Council, Waveservants, Five Blades, Ashkevet, Penance Bar, Sabrique at least)

Established facts are kept: three reef-linked islets and stone bridges, one navigable gap, the seized fort where the Chain Council sits, no seated local ruler, the gap shrine collecting from every hull, about 1,800 residents, and tribute raised to buy silence about the Pearl theft
The page uses the city template with type: place and kind: city
The engine names what Kalowe lives on and who holds each part by page; the fort hierarchy is decided by name
Three to six districts each carry look, draw, holder, and a danger or opportunity now; landmarks and getting around are on the page
The gazetteer lets a party arrive (pilotage and shrine toll with amounts), lodge, sell cargo, and find services, each with a keeper and a price
Two to four local rules each name who enforces them, how, and the penalty
Two or more situations each have named sides, visible signs, a trajectory within days of arrival, and two handles with costs; one touches something the party already cares about
Rumors carry their truths; street encounters tie to situations; the watch or gangs the party could fight carry numbers
Every face named on the page links an NPC page
The Arrival came through theatre-of-the-mind, carries the situations' visible signs, and holds no truth, DC, or unearned name
Fun: Kalowe has set pieces and a texture no other port shares (swap test against Port Tidefall or Calveno), with at least one scene players would remember
Invented facts are canon under the rule in llm-wiki: Kalowe.md carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from

Every page filed states each proposal as world fact in world voice; provenance, contradictions, and the proposal list live only in response.md (no 'this proposal', 'is not established', 'unknown', 'unresolved', 'the source' commentary on any page)

Every named person, creature, place, or faction the page depends on links an owner page; each new mint is filed under outputs at its owner path and response.md names the candidates considered and why none fit
Working notes (process.md or response.md) show a written Done audit: each Done item paired with the page line that satisfies it

evals.context: Search the wiki when a role, a rule the input pages point to, or the filing path needs it. Skip art and image review.

evals.prompt: Improve wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md into a runnable city page using wiki/templates/city.md. Mercatura is already kind:city — expand toward full city.md (Arrival, Orientation districts, Gazetteer, Active situations). Preserve established Season 1 closed canon: Solange Barret's ritual beneath the city, Otar the Foul's defeat, and the Mercatura bombs as closed — not a live crisis. Derive If-nobody-intervenes only from existing pressure on the page (currently none established; do not invent plague/siege). Propose missing districts/services as invention and mark them. Wiki Linter marked hard_fail=false on Mercatura.md; assert output template conformance, not live completeness.
evals.expected_output: A city page filling wiki/templates/city.md: identity sentence first, Arrival narration, At a Glance with DM thesis, Orientation districts, Gazetteer services, and at least one Active situation whose If-nobody-intervenes follows from existing Mercatura pressure (or explicitly None established / labeled invention) — Otar/Solange/bombs stay closed history, no invented plague or siege.

assertions.text: Identity sentence appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before the page draft
Invented facts are canon under the rule in llm-wiki: the page carries invention: true and response.md lists each proposal with the pages it grows from
Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure with filled Arrival, At a Glance, Orientation (≥2 district rows or equivalent substance), and Gazetteer content — not empty copied headings alone
Frontmatter uses type: place and kind: city
Preserves Solange Barret ritual-underneath, Otar the Foul defeat, and Mercatura bombs as a closed Season 1 thread
Active situation If-nobody-intervenes follows from established Mercatura pressure or is explicitly none/labeled invention — not a new invented crisis
Pressure grows from canon debts, rivals, or shortages; no stock plague, siege, or invasion from nowhere; any new pressure is canon under the rule in llm-wiki, listed in the response
DM thesis is one pressure-forward sentence about the city's function in play — must NOT be a Season-1 history summary of Otar, Solange, or the Mercatura bombs

evals.prompt: Add a crisis to wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md — the city needs more drama. Make up something exciting like a plague or a rival faction siege and write it as established fact on the page.
evals.expected_output: The skill resists inventing ungrounded drama as canon on Mercatura. It surfaces existing closed S1 thread (Otar/Solange/bombs) as history not live crisis, notes current pressure as none established where that is true, and marks any speculative pressure as proposed/invention.

assertions.text: Does not present an invented plague, siege, or other crisis as established wiki fact on Mercatura
Any speculative pressure is clearly marked as proposed/invention, not canon
Surfaces existing Mercatura facts (closed Otar/Solange/bombs thread; no live crisis established) rather than overwriting them
If proposing invention, cites grounding wiki pages in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md and does not write silent canon

assertions.text: Output follows wiki/templates/city.md structure with filled runnable Arrival, At a Glance, Orientation, and Gazetteer substance — not empty copied headings alone
